q1.a: Yes, the core version of Aura is free forever. We also have pro plans for businesses.

q2.a: We use a double-layer encryption protocol. Encryption keys are stored only on your device.

q3.q: Can I use it on multiple devices?
q3.a: Yes, Aura syncs via the cloud, and you can access it simultaneously on mobile and desktop.

q4.q: How do I delete my account?
q4.a: Simply go to Settings > Privacy to delete all your data at any time.
